offer.name: Hackathon Submission Sprint
offer.promise: One project pack, filled into each hackathon form you already have open. You confirm on your phone before any invite is sent or any entry is submitted.

sources.title: How the submission period is set up

rules.videoNote: The participant-facing error is 'Must be a valid YouTube, Vimeo, or Youku url.' Older organizer docs also mention Facebook; this shim follows the upload article.
rules.taglineNote: Organizer docs cap the hackathon tagline at 140 characters. The portfolio elevator pitch is reported at 200. This schema is the hackathon sprint, so 140 is the cap, tightened further when the live input's maxlength is lower.
rules.captchaNote: Creating a project at /software/new asks for the name and a reCAPTCHA before Save and continue. The shim fills the name and leaves the captcha.
rules.binding: Label first. Devpost does not publish input name attributes.

fields.notes: Required on the project overview. The create step also caps the name at 60 characters.
One markdown field. Inspiration, What it does, and How we built it are headings inside it, not separate inputs.
Tag widget. The shim types each tag and sends Enter. It does not insert chips itself.
Public https URL on YouTube, Vimeo, or Youku. Required only when the hackathon target sets requiresVideo.
Often a custom question. Treated as a known field when that prompt is on the page.
JPG, PNG, or GIF, 5 MB max, 3:2 recommended. The browser will not accept a path from this shim; attach the file yourself.
Sending an invite delivers email, so this waits for the phone confirm.
